Test Scenario: Successful login with email and password
Test Case Description: Verify that a user can successfully log in with valid credentials.
Test Steps:
1. Go to the login page.
2. Enter a valid email and password.
3. Click the 'Login' button.
Expected Result: User is redirected to the dashboard/feed and a success message is shown.
UI/UX Checks:
- 'Login' button shows a loader on click and is disabled.
- Cursor is a pointer on hover over the 'Login' button.
- Success toast 'Logged in successfully' is shown.
- Form fields show inline validation errors for invalid formats (e.g., bad email).

Test Scenario: Login with invalid credentials
Test Case Description: Verify that appropriate error feedback is given for invalid login attempts.
Test Steps:
1. Go to the login page.
2. Enter invalid credentials.
3. Click the 'Login' button.
Expected Result: An error message is displayed, and the user remains on the login page.
UI/UX Checks:
- Error toast 'Invalid credentials' or similar is shown.
- Loader on the 'Login' button disappears, and the button is re-enabled.

Test Scenario: Successful logout
Test Case Description: Verify that a user can successfully log out from any page.
Test Steps:
1. From any page, click on the user profile icon.
2. Click the 'Logout' button.
Expected Result: User is redirected to the login page and the session is terminated.
UI/UX Checks:
- Cursor is a pointer on hover over the 'Logout' button.
- A success toast 'You have been logged out' may be shown on the login page.

Test Scenario: View the main content feed
Test Case Description: Verify the user's personalized feed loads correctly.
Preconditions: User is following other users or topics.
Test Steps:
1. Log in.
2. Navigate to the main feed page.
Expected Result: The feed displays a list of relevant items (posts, publications, etc.).
UI/UX Checks:
- A loading skeleton/spinner is shown while the feed is being fetched.
- If the feed is empty, an 'Empty State' message is shown.
- As the user scrolls down, more items are loaded automatically (infinite scroll) with a loader visible at the bottom.

Test Scenario: Like a post directly from the feed
Test Case Description: Verify a user can like/upvote a post from the feed view.
Test Steps:
1. Find a post in the feed.
2. Click the 'Like' or 'Upvote' button on the post.
Expected Result: The button's state changes to 'liked', and the count updates without a page reload.
UI/UX Checks:
- The 'Like' button shows a brief loader or animation.
- An error toast is shown if the action fails.

Test Scenario: Attempt to access the feed page while not logged in
Test Case Description: Verify that a non-logged-in user is redirected to login when trying to access the feed.
Test Steps: 1. Navigate directly to the /feed URL.
Expected Result: The user is redirected to the login page.

Test Scenario: View the list of published blog posts
Test Case Description: Verify that any user can see the list of published blog posts.
Preconditions: At least one blog post is published.
Test Steps: 1. Navigate to the /blog page.
Expected Result: A list/grid of blog posts is displayed.
UI/UX Checks:
- A loading skeleton/spinner is shown while posts are being fetched.
- Blog post cards have a pointer cursor on hover.
- If there are no posts, an 'Empty State' message like 'No blog posts yet' is displayed.

Test Scenario: View a single blog post
Test Case Description: Verify that any user can view a published blog post's full content.
Test Steps: 1. From the blog list page, click on a blog post title.
Expected Result: The full blog post content is displayed.
UI/UX Checks:
- A loading skeleton/spinner is shown while the post is being fetched.
- Images in the post have 'alt' text for accessibility.

Test Scenario: Add a comment to a blog post
Test Case Description: Verify that a logged-in user can add a comment.
Test Steps:
1. Go to a blog post detail page.
2. Write a comment.
3. Click 'Post Comment'.
Expected Result: The comment is added to the blog post.
UI/UX Checks:
- 'Post Comment' button shows a loader and is disabled on click.
- A success toast 'Comment posted' is shown.
- The new comment appears in the list without a page refresh.

Test Scenario: Create and publish a new blog post
Test Case Description: Verify that a user can create and publish a new blog post.
Test Steps:
1. Navigate to the 'Add Blog' page.
2. Fill in the title and content.
3. Click 'Publish'.
Expected Result: The new blog post is created and the user is redirected to the new post's page.
UI/UX Checks:
- 'Publish' button is disabled if required fields are empty.
- 'Publish' button shows a loader and is disabled on click.
- A success toast 'Post published successfully' is shown on redirect.

Test Scenario: Draft content is restored from local storage on page refresh
Test Case Description: Verify that if the page is refreshed, the user doesn't lose their work.
Test Steps:
1. Start typing a new post.
2. Refresh the page.
Expected Result: The editor reloads and is pre-filled with the content from local storage.
UI/UX Checks: - A toast or modal 'We have restored your unsaved changes' should appear, with an option to discard.

Test Scenario: View own profile information
Test Case Description: Verify that a user can view their own profile information.
Test Steps:
1. Click on the profile icon.
2. Select 'My Profile'.
Expected Result: The user's profile page is displayed with their information.
UI/UX Checks: - A loading skeleton is shown while profile data is fetched.

Feature: Follow a user from their profile
Test Scenario: Verify a user can follow another user.
Test Case Description: Target user exists.
Preconditions:
1. Go to another user's profile page.
2. Click the 'Follow' button.
Test Steps: The user is now following the target user. The button text changes to 'Unfollow'.
Expected Result:
- 'Follow' button shows a loader and is disabled on click.
- A success toast 'You are now following [username]' is shown.
- The follower count on the profile may update.

Test Scenario: Verify non-logged-in user is prompted to log in.
Test Case Description: Target user exists.
Preconditions:
1. Go to another user's profile page.
2. Click the 'Follow' button.
Test Steps: An authentication modal is displayed.
Expected Result: - The 'Follow' button has a pointer cursor on hover, even when logged out.

Test Scenario: Icon-only buttons have labels
Test Case Description: Verify that buttons that only have an icon still have a text label for screen readers.
Preconditions: An icon-only button (e.g., for upvoting, deleting) exists.
Test Steps:
1. Hover over an icon-only button.
2. Use a screen reader or browser dev tools to inspect the element.
Expected Result:
A tooltip with the action's name appears on hover.
The button has an 'aria-label' attribute (e.g., aria-label='Upvote').

Test Scenario: Check layout on a small screen
Test Case Description: Verify that the page layout adapts correctly for mobile devices.
Test Steps: 1. Open a page on a mobile device or a small browser window.
Expected Result:
- The layout should be single-column.
- No horizontal scrolling should be required.
- Navigation may be collapsed into a hamburger menu.
